notes.title: Playtest #3
notes.content:
Another playtest??!! Yes! and we've got some juicy new stuff!
Our third Steam playtest will be live from 16:00 CEST 28/08 until 31/08/2025! 🗓️



Notable changes:

A Tutorial to guide new recruits

Grenades are in! And if the standard boom isn’t enough, try out some explosive upgrades

A brand-new HUB area

The first taste of Skill Tree progression (limited for now, but a glimpse of what’s coming!)

For the Full changelist please check our discord 
https://discord.gg/xzNvYEp2ms



Please note that this is a playtest, while we did our best to deliver a very polished and fun build there is still some missing features and there will be bugs 🐞.



If you encounter a bug, please report it in: ⁠🐞Discord | Bugs or Galactic Vault | Discussions

If you have suggestions or ideas, let us know in: ⁠💡Discord | Suggestions or Galactic Vault | Discussions



Scrap those weekend plans and play some Galactic Vault ːsteamhappyː
